relationships.subject: bradykinin
relationships.evidence_quote: bradykinin provoked a cluster of action potentials in 20 and capsaicin in 23 neurons

relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: Specific spinal trigeminal neurons with afferent input from the cranial dura mater respond to stimulation of paranasal cavities with noxious agents like bradykinin and capsaicin

key_findings: Spinal trigeminal neurons with dural input responded to bradykinin (20/25) and capsaicin (23/25) applied to the paranasal cavities in rats.
Convergent trigeminal input from dura and nasal cavities may explain rhinosinusitis headache.
